spans.s: उर्विया, ind., Ved. far, far off, far and near, widely.

उर्वी, f. the wide earth, the earth, the soil; space,
the open space or great expanse comprising the six
spaces, viz. the four quarters of the sky with the upper
and lower spaces; a river; (वी), du., Ved. the two
worlds, or heaven and earth.
—उर्वी-धर, अस्, m.
a mountain; the serpent Śeṣa.
—उर्वी-पति, इस्, m.
a king.
—उर्वी-भृत्, त्, m. a mountain.
—उर्वी-
रुह, अस्, m. a tree, ‘growing on the earth.’
—उर्वीश
(˚वी-ईश), अस्, m. a king.
ऊर्वी ऊर्वी. See under ऊरु.
उर्व्या, f. protection, security.
ऊर्व्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in reservoirs, lakes, &c.

उर्व्य्-ऊति, इस्, इस्, इ, (fr. उर्विया-ऊति ?), Ved. able to
help or defend far and near; (Sāy.) granting extensive
protection.

उर्व् उर्व्, cl. 1. P. ऊर्वति, ऊर्वाञ्-चकार,
ऊर्वितुम्, to kill or hurt.
उर्व उर्व, अस्, m., N. of a man.

ऊर्व 1. ऊर्व, अस्, m. (fr. rt. वृ), Ved. a re-
ceptacle (for water), a reservoir; a cloud; an enclosed
place, a stable for cattle; a prison, captivity (?); an
epithet of the Pitṛs or manes of deceased ancestors.

ऊर्व 2. ऊर्व, अस्, m. (fr. ऊरु ?), N. of a saint
from whose thighs sprang Aurva, a fiery being received
by the ocean; the submarine fire; N. of a prince.
उर्वट उर्वट, अस्, m. a year.

उर्वरा उर्वरा, f., Ved. fertile soil, yielding
every kind of crop, field sown with corn; land in
general; a mixed mass of fibres, wool, &c.; jocular
term for curled hairs; N. of an Apsaras.
—उर्वरा-
जित्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. acquiring fields.
—उर्वरा-पति,
इस्, m., Ved. master of the fields sown with corn.
—उर्वरा-सा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. granting fields.

ऊर्वरा ऊर्वरा, f. fertile soil, land bearing
any and every crop. See उर्वरा.
उर्वरी, f., Ved. tow, fibres drawn out of the distaff.

उर्वर्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. belonging to a field
which is sown with corn.

उर्वशी उर्वशी, f. (fr. उरु-वशी), Ved. wish,
ardour, hot desire; N. of an Apsaras or nymph of
Indra's heaven, who became the wife of Purūravas;
she is also identified with the Gaṅgā.
—उर्वशी-
नाम-माला, f., N. of a glossary of synonymous
words by an anonymous author.
—उर्वशी-रमण,
अस्, m. epithet of Aila or Purūravas, the second king
of the lunar race and the husband of the Apsaras
Urvaśī.
—उर्वशी-वल्लभ or उर्वशी-सहाय, अस्,
m. epithet of Purūravas; see the preceding.

उर्वशी; add — according to some, more properly
derived fr. उरु + rt. 1. अश्, to pervade, and meaning
originally ‘widely-spreading.’

ऊर्वशी ऊर्वशी, f., N. of an Apsaras. See
उर्वशी.

उर्वारु उर्वारु, उस्, m. a kind of cucumber,
Cucumis Usitatissimus. See इर्वारु.
उर्वारू, ऊस्, f., Ved. = the preceding.
उर्वारुक, अम्, n. the fruit of the above plant.
ऊर्वष्ठीव ऊर्व्-अष्ठीव. See under ऊरु.

ऊर्व्यङ्ग ऊर्व्यङ्ग, अम्, n. (said to be fr.
ऊर्वी = उर्वी, ‘earth,’ and अङ्ग), a mushroom.
